description: Meridian (SimplexDM v2.0.0) offline map label manifest. A curated world base database (data/labels-world-base.db) and Amsterdam Metro sample region pack (data/samples/amsterdam-labels.rlp) ship pre-installed. Build custom city or country packs from any OpenStreetMap extract using scripts/build_world_labels.py and scripts/pack_region.py, or configure HTTPS mirrors below.
